rows.text: When the Omen Vanguards delivered their revelation to Planet Kromor, the locals were already obsessed with art. During the Great Painting Festival, Kromorians spent every waking hour hunting for the perfect pigment mix, desperate to recreate the legendary "Iridescent Black" from ancient texts. They threw nearly everything they owned into their melting pots. Two Amber Eras later, a collector named Mr. Singularity visited and found the entire surface drained of color, save for a single, writhing mass of colorful black pigment. He tucked the glob into his collection and moved on. They say that late at night, that splash of color still squirms in its dish, hungering for more.
